exceptions.reason: The user guide lives on each app's own website, which a template does not have.
The user guide's pages under /docs/ belong to each app's own website.
Each app's user guide has its own page listing its conformance and exceptions.
Each app's repository requires its own format and test checks before a change is merged.
Each app's README shows its own screenshots; the template's are placeholders.
Each app's website serves its own user guide for each version.
Each app's website makes its own command and settings pages and What's new from the app.
Each app captures its own screenshots from itself; the template's are placeholders.
Each app's website makes its conformance page from the app's own list of exceptions.
